bonker.name: Bonker
bonker.desc: Cheap club-swinging infantry. Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

pebbler.name: Pebbler
pebbler.desc: Slings rocks over friends. Ricochet: each rock bounces to one more enemy nearby. Hits air.

tuskback.name: Tuskback
tuskback.desc: Armored charger. Gore: the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks the target back.

spear_hunter.name: Spear Hunter
spear_hunter.desc: Anti-heavy with reach: strikes from the second rank, deals triple damage to armored and mech targets and goes for them first. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

drum_shaman.name: Drum Shaman
drum_shaman.desc: Support. Drums give nearby allies +20% attack speed. Stays behind the front line.

sabertooth.name: Sabertooth
sabertooth.desc: Fast skirmisher. Pounce: when blocked, leaps past the front to bite an enemy ranged or support unit for double damage.

mammoth_matriarch.name: Mammoth Matriarch
mammoth_matriarch.desc: Legendary siege beast. Tramples groups with splash damage while two riders sling rocks at ground and air. When she falls, the riders jump off as two Pebblers.

hunting_wolves.name: Hunting Wolves
hunting_wolves.desc: Squad ×2: one card trains two fast wolves that bite on their own beat. Each wolf is weak alone; splash and sweeps hit both.

hide_shield.name: Hide Shield
hide_shield.desc: Guard infantry behind a mammoth-hide shield: takes 25% less damage from attacks with range 100 or more (not powers). Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

torch_runner.name: Torch Runner
torch_runner.desc: Raider: very fast, and its torch deals double damage to the enemy base. Fragile: anything that blocks it wins.

bolas_thrower.name: Bolas Thrower
bolas_thrower.desc: Whirls a three-ball bolas: each hit slows the target 20% for 1.5 s. Ground only.

woolly_rhino.name: Woolly Rhino
woolly_rhino.desc: Armored heavy with a horn hook that hits 2 enemies at once. No charge bonus: steady damage every swing.

atlatl_thrower.name: Atlatl Thrower
atlatl_thrower.desc: Long range: hurls darts in a high arc from far behind the front, splashing a small area where the target stood. Cannot hit units closer than 90 or air; half damage to bases.

boulder_hurler.name: Boulder Hurler
boulder_hurler.desc: Ranged anti-heavy: heaves boulders that deal triple damage to armored and mech targets and go for them first, but half to light units. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.desc: Support. Heals the 2 most hurt allies nearby for 30 HP per second in all. Stays behind the front line.

pelt_rager.name: Pelt Rager
pelt_rager.desc: Frenzy: below half health it deals 30% more damage and attacks 20% faster. Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

beast_caller.name: Beast Caller
beast_caller.desc: Summoner: calls a Cave Pup every 8 s at no gold cost, two at a time. Pups use no population, pay no bounty and always march. Stays behind the front line.

cave_bear.name: Cave Bear
cave_bear.desc: Armored brawler with a huge paw swat. Roar: every 14 s, stuns nearby enemies for 1 s (Legendaries half as long).

rockfall_shaman.name: Rockfall Shaman
rockfall_shaman.desc: Caster: every 9 s a boulder falls on the nearest enemy ground unit within 380, crushing a small area. Stays behind the front line.

elk_chieftain.name: Elk Chieftain
elk_chieftain.desc: Legendary war leader on a giant elk. Its antler sweep hits 2 enemies, the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks back, and its war horn gives nearby allies +15% damage.

cave_pup.name: Cave Pup
cave_pup.desc: A small, fast wolf pup sent by a Beast Caller. It always marches.

shield_bearer.name: Shield Bearer
shield_bearer.desc: Guard infantry behind a big oval shield: takes 25% less damage from attacks with range 100 or more (not powers). Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

thracian_raider.name: Thracian Raider
thracian_raider.desc: Raider: very fast, and its curved blade deals double damage to the enemy base. Fragile: anything that blocks it wins.

rhodian_slingers.name: Rhodian Slingers
rhodian_slingers.desc: Squad ×3: one card trains three slingers who loose stones on their own beat. Each is weak alone; splash and sweeps hit them all. Hits air.

discus_thrower.name: Discus Thrower
discus_thrower.desc: Spins and hurls a bronze discus that skips on to a second enemy nearby. Hits air.

war_elephant.name: War Elephant
war_elephant.desc: Armored brute. Its trunk lash and stomp hit two enemies at once; no charge bonus.

cretan_archer.name: Cretan Archer
cretan_archer.desc: Long range: arcs arrows onto a spot far behind the front for splash damage. Cannot hit enemies closer than 90, or air. Half damage to bases.

belly_bowman.name: Belly Bowman
belly_bowman.desc: Ranged anti-heavy: spans a huge belly-bow and deals triple damage to armored and mech targets, which it shoots first. Weak against light troops. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

aulos_piper.name: Aulos Piper
aulos_piper.desc: Support. Marching tunes make nearby allies move 15% faster. Stays behind the front line.

tragic_chorus.name: Tragic Chorus
tragic_chorus.desc: Dread: enemy ground troops near the chorus move 20% slower. Stays behind the front line; outranged by archers and javelins.

wooden_horse.name: Wooden Horse
wooden_horse.desc: Siege: rolls past troops to ram the enemy base for heavy damage. Two spearmen poke from its hatches; when it breaks, two Hoplites jump out.

amazon_rider.name: Amazon Rider
amazon_rider.desc: Fast skirmisher. When blocked, rides around the front to strike an enemy ranged or support unit for double damage.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.desc: Armored brawler. Its horn charge deals double damage and knocks back; below half HP it rages for more damage and faster blows.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.desc: Legendary beast. Three heads bite three enemies in turn, and its venom slows them. Splash and anti-heavy troops are its answer.

net_caster.name: Net Caster
net_caster.desc: Casts a weighted net that slows the target by 30% for 2 s. Hits ground and air.

polybolos.name: Polybolos
polybolos.desc: A chain-fed bolt-thrower that looses three bolts in a row at long range. Hits ground and air.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: Whole lane, no aim: a sandstorm lashes up to 8 enemies nearest your gate, anywhere on the lane, and slows their moves and attacks by 30% for 3 s. Light damage.

charybdis.name: Charybdis
charybdis.desc: A whirlpool opens in your half: it pulls up to 6 ground enemies together, slows their moves and attacks and chips them for 4 s.

hoplon_line.name: Hoplon Line
hoplon_line.desc: A wall of locked shields on a pad. Your ground troops just behind it take 20% less damage from ranged attacks.

slinger_camp.name: Skirmisher Camp
slinger_camp.desc: A camp on a pad that sends a weak javelin-throwing Skirmisher Levy every 12 s (one at a time).

slinger_levy.name: Skirmisher Levy
slinger_levy.desc: A weak javelin thrower sent by a Skirmisher Camp. It always marches.

quill_porcupine.name: Quill Porcupine
quill_porcupine.desc: Turret: puffs up and fires a fan of 3 quills, each piercing 2 enemies in a line. Hits ground and air. Great against swarms.

sapling_sling.name: Sapling Sling
sapling_sling.desc: Turret: a bent sapling flings a big stone in a high arc, splashing a wide area. Long range, but it cannot hit units right under it or air.

pebble_hail.name: Pebble Hail
pebble_hail.desc: Whole lane, no aim: pebbles rain on up to 8 enemies nearest your gate, wherever they are, ground and air. Light damage.

tangle_vines.name: Tangle Vines
tangle_vines.desc: Vines burst in your half: they pull up to 6 ground enemies together, slow their moves and attacks and chip them for 4 s.

thorn_hedge.name: Thorn Hedge
thorn_hedge.desc: A cheap wall of thorny brush for 100 gold. Placed on a Home pad, it stops enemy ground units in front of your turrets, but it breaks sooner than a Palisade.

bone_watchtower.name: Bone Watchtower
bone_watchtower.desc: A field tower that lobs stones in an arc, splashing a small area. Ground only. Heavies break it twice as fast.

squire_pair.name: Squires
squire_pair.desc: Squad ×2: one card trains two eager squires who lunge with practice swords on their own beat. Each is weak alone; splash and sweeps hit both. Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

flailman.name: Flailman
flailman.desc: Spins a flail overhead and smashes down: each blow hits 2 enemies at once. Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

brigand.name: Brigand
brigand.desc: Raider: very fast, and his dagger deals double damage to the enemy base. Fragile: anything that blocks him wins.

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.desc: Cranks a heavy crossbow: slow shots that hit hard, and 25% harder against armored targets. Hits air.

greatsword_knight.name: Greatsword Knight
greatsword_knight.desc: Armored heavy with a two-handed sword: each sweep hits 2 enemies at once. No charge bonus: steady damage every swing.

yeoman_archer.name: Yeoman Archer
yeoman_archer.desc: Long range: looses arrows in a high arc from far behind the front, splashing a small area where the target stood. Cannot hit units closer than 90, or air. Half damage to bases.

warhammer_sergeant.name: Warhammer Sergeant
warhammer_sergeant.desc: Anti-heavy hammer: deals triple damage to armored and mech targets and goes for them first. Each hit cracks the armour: the target takes 20% more damage for 3 s. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

herald.name: Herald
herald.desc: Support. Every 9 s a fanfare shields the 4 nearest allies (61 for 5 s). Stays behind the front line.

kennel_master.name: Kennel Master
kennel_master.desc: Summoner: unleashes a War Hound every 9 s at no gold cost, two at a time. Hounds use no population, pay no bounty and always march. Stays behind the front line.

mangonel_cart.name: Mangonel
mangonel_cart.desc: Artillery cart: hurls a stone in a high arc for big splash damage. Cannot hit units closer than 80, or air. Half damage to bases.

siege_belfry.name: Siege Belfry
siege_belfry.desc: Armored siege tower: its drawbridge slams the enemy while two archers shoot from the top at ground and air. When it breaks, two Footmen jump out.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: Caster: tosses vials, and every 9 s a bubbling flask bursts on the nearest enemy ground unit within 360, splashing a small area. Stays behind the front line.

lindworm.name: Lindworm
lindworm.desc: Legendary dragon. Its green fire breath burns the target and up to 4 more enemies behind it. Anti-heavy troops are its answer.

war_hound.name: War Hound
war_hound.desc: A fast hunting hound sent by a Kennel Master. It always marches.

springald.name: Springald
springald.desc: Turret: winches back and looses a huge bolt that skewers up to 3 ground enemies in a line.

grapple_crane.name: Grapple Crane
grapple_crane.desc: Turret: swings a hook onto an armored enemy (else the nearest) and winches it back toward your gate. Big units are dragged half as far. Ground only.

longbow_volley.name: Longbow Volley
longbow_volley.desc: Whole lane, no aim: a volley of longbow arrows falls on up to 8 enemies nearest your gate, wherever they are, ground and air. Light damage.

great_bell.name: Great Bell
great_bell.desc: A great bell tolls in your half: up to 5 ground enemies in the zone are dazed and stop for 2 s (Legendaries 1 s).

bear_snares.name: Bear Snares
bear_snares.desc: A trap of hidden snares on a pad: it bites 4 times, each a small hit that slows the enemy 40% for 2 s.

crossbow_keep.name: Crossbow Keep
crossbow_keep.desc: A field tower with crossbows: its bolts slow the target 25% for 1.5 s. Heavies break it twice as fast.

highlander.name: Highlander
highlander.desc: Guard infantry behind a round targe: takes 25% less damage from attacks with range 100 or more (not powers). Blunt: deals less damage to armored targets.

powder_monkey.name: Powder Monkey
powder_monkey.desc: Raider: very fast, and his powder scoop deals double damage to the enemy base. When he falls, his little cask pops and hurts enemies close by.

voltigeurs.name: Voltigeurs
voltigeurs.desc: Squad ×3: one card trains three skirmishers who kneel and fire in a ripple. Each is weak alone; splash and sweeps hit them all. Hits air.

blunderbuss.name: Blunderbuss
blunderbuss.desc: Short range: the flared gun blasts the target and up to 2 more enemies just behind it. Hits air.

dragoon.name: Dragoon
dragoon.desc: Armored heavy on horseback: halts and fires a carbine at range 90, splashing a small area.

coehorn_crew.name: Coehorn Crew
coehorn_crew.desc: Long range: two gunners lob mortar shells in a high arc from far behind the front, splashing a small area where the target stood. Cannot hit units closer than 90, or air. Half damage to bases.

wall_gunner.name: Wall Gunner
wall_gunner.desc: Ranged anti-heavy: a long wall-gun on a rest deals triple damage to armored and mech targets and goes for them first, but half to light units. Ground only. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

drummer_boy.name: Drummer Boy
drummer_boy.desc: Support. His drumroll makes nearby allies attack 15% faster. Stays behind the front line.

bagpiper.name: Bagpiper
bagpiper.desc: Dread: the droning pipes make enemy ground troops within 130 move 20% slower. Stays behind the front line.

rocket_cart.name: Rocket Cart
rocket_cart.desc: Artillery cart: fires a rack of 4 rockets that land scattered around the target, each with a small splash. Cannot hit units closer than 90, or air. Half damage to bases.

hussar.name: Hussar
hussar.desc: Fast skirmisher. Pounce: when blocked, swerves past the front to slash an enemy ranged or support unit for double damage.

mesmerist.name: Mesmerist
mesmerist.desc: Caster: every 15 s his swinging watch dazes every enemy near him for 1 s (Legendaries half as long). Stays behind the front line.

grand_marshal.name: Grand Marshal
grand_marshal.desc: Legendary commander. His sabre sweep hits 2 enemies, nearby allies deal 15% more damage, and every 10 s he calls a cannonball onto the nearest enemy within 400.

carronade.name: Carronade
carronade.desc: Turret: a short, fat gun that hits hard every 2.5 s and goes for armored enemies first. Ground only.

sea_mortar.name: Sea Mortar
sea_mortar.desc: Turret: lobs a heavy shell in a high arc, splashing a wide area. Long range, but it cannot hit units right under it or air.

rocket_volley.name: Rocket Volley
rocket_volley.desc: Whole lane, no aim: a rocket streaks down on each of up to 8 enemies nearest your gate, wherever they are, ground and air. Light damage.

cannon_salute.name: Cannon Salute
cannon_salute.desc: A ring of salute guns fires in your half: up to 6 ground enemies in the zone take a blast and are deafened, stopping for 2 s (Legendaries 1 s).

cavalry_picket.name: Cavalry Picket
cavalry_picket.desc: A camp on a pad that sends a Picket Rider, a light horseman, every 18 s (one at a time).

fougasse.name: Fougasse
fougasse.desc: A buried powder mine on a Home pad: it blasts twice, each blast hitting the group around the first enemy to reach it. Never hits air.

picket_rider.name: Picket Rider
picket_rider.desc: A light horseman sent by a Cavalry Picket. It always marches.

training_dummy.name: Training Dummy
training_dummy.desc: A straw target for practice. It barely fights back.

rock_tosser.name: Rock Tosser
rock_tosser.desc: Lobs a boulder at a single target. Hits ground and air.

angry_beehive.name: Angry Beehive
angry_beehive.desc: Releases a steady stream of angry bees: short range, lots of little stings. Hits ground and air.

log_roller.name: Log Roller
log_roller.desc: Rolls a log along the ground near your gate, hitting up to 6 enemies, nearest first.

grumpy_toad.name: Grumpy Toad
grumpy_toad.desc: Grabs an enemy ranged or support unit with its tongue and drags it toward your gate.

hoplite.name: Hoplite
hoplite.desc: Shield-and-spear infantry. Shield Bash: the first hit of each fight shoves the target back. Blunt against armor.

javelineer.name: Javelineer
javelineer.desc: Throws javelins that pierce a second enemy standing close behind the first. Hits ground and air.

war_chariot.name: War Chariot
war_chariot.desc: Fast armored chariot. Scythe Charge: the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks the target back.

phalangite.name: Phalangite
phalangite.desc: Anti-heavy with a very long pike: strikes from the second rank, deals triple damage to armored and mech targets and goes for them first. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

standard_bearer.name: Standard Bearer
standard_bearer.desc: Support. The raised standard gives nearby allies +15% damage. Stays behind the front line.

scorpion.name: Scorpion
scorpion.desc: Artillery bolt-thrower. Each bolt pierces up to 3 ground enemies in a row. Cannot hit enemies up close.

bronze_colossus.name: Bronze Colossus
bronze_colossus.desc: Legendary bronze giant. Its stomps deal splash damage and slow every enemy hit. When it falls, its molten heart bursts over nearby ground enemies.

archer_tower.name: Archer Tower
archer_tower.desc: Archers fire at a single target. Hits ground and air.

sun_mirror.name: Sun Mirror
sun_mirror.desc: Focuses sunlight into a fast, short-range beam. Hits ground and air.

onager.name: Onager
onager.desc: Flings stones far across the lane for splash damage. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

gorgon_bust.name: Gorgon Bust
gorgon_bust.desc: Its gaze picks armored targets first and turns them to stone: the target is stunned for 1.5 s. Hits ground and air.

footman.name: Footman
footman.desc: Sturdy infantry. Shield Wall: takes 25% less damage from ranged attacks. Blunt against armor.

longbowman.name: Longbowman
longbowman.desc: Long-range archer. Hits ground and air.

destrier_knight.name: Destrier Knight
destrier_knight.desc: Armored cavalry. Lance charge: the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks the target back.

pikeman.name: Pikeman
pikeman.desc: Anti-heavy with reach. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses. Deals triple damage to armored and mech targets.

friar.name: Friar
friar.desc: Support. Heals the two most wounded allies nearby. Stays behind the front line.

battering_ram.name: Battering Ram
battering_ram.desc: Siege engine that heads straight for the enemy base and hits it hard. Fights units only when blocked.

ursa_paladin.name: Ursa Paladin
ursa_paladin.desc: Legendary bear knight. Cleaves two enemies at once, and every 15 s its roar shields nearby allies.

crossbow_nest.name: Crossbow Nest
crossbow_nest.desc: Fires heavy bolts at a single target. Hits ground and air.

pitch_cauldron.name: Pitch Cauldron
pitch_cauldron.desc: Pours burning pitch on up to 4 ground enemies right at your gate.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.desc: Hurls boulders far across the lane for splash damage. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

honk_ballista.name: Honk Ballista
honk_ballista.desc: Launches a goose that bounces between 3 enemies and slows them. Hits ground and air.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.desc: Infantry with a boarding hook: the first hit of each fight pulls the target closer. Blunt against armor.

fusilier.name: Fusilier
fusilier.desc: Musket infantry with long range and heavy shots. Hits ground and air.

cuirassier.name: Cuirassier
cuirassier.desc: Armored cavalry. Charge: the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks the target back.

grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.desc: Anti-heavy. Lobs grenades over allies for splash damage, ×2.5 against armored and mech targets. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses.

field_surgeon.name: Field Surgeon
field_surgeon.desc: Support. Heals the two most wounded allies nearby. Stays behind the front line.

bronze_cannon.name: Bronze Cannon
bronze_cannon.desc: Artillery. Fires cannonballs in an arc for heavy splash damage. Cannot hit enemies up close.

balloon_admiral.name: Balloon Admiral
balloon_admiral.desc: Legendary air bomber. Drifts over the lane dropping bombs on ground enemies, then bombs the base. Crashes with a big explosion when shot down.

swivel_gun.name: Swivel Gun
swivel_gun.desc: Rapid musket fire at a single target. Hits ground and air.

grapeshot_gun.name: Grapeshot Gun
grapeshot_gun.desc: Blasts the frontmost enemy and everyone just behind it. Hits ground and air.

congreve_rack.name: Congreve Rack
congreve_rack.desc: Fires a volley of 4 scattering rockets for splash damage. Extra damage to air.

chainshot_cannon.name: Chainshot Cannon
chainshot_cannon.desc: Fires chained shot that pierces up to 4 ground enemies in a row.

riveter.name: Riveter
riveter.desc: Tough infantry with an oversized wrench. Big Wrench: the first hit of each fight deals 50% more damage. Blunt against armor.

carbineer.name: Carbineer
carbineer.desc: Quick carbine fire at long range. Hits ground and air.

steam_golem.name: Steam Golem
steam_golem.desc: Armored steam machine. Piston Punch: the first hit of each fight deals double damage and knocks the target back.

harpoon_gunner.name: Harpoon Gunner
harpoon_gunner.desc: Anti-heavy. Triple damage to armored and mech targets, which it aims at first. Reel In: the first hit of each fight pulls the target closer. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses. Hits ground and air.

flare_spotter.name: Flare Spotter
flare_spotter.desc: Support. Flares mark armored targets first: marked enemies take 20% more damage from everything. Stays behind the front line.

sapper.name: Sapper
sapper.desc: Siege runner that heads straight for the enemy base and hits it hard. Fights units only when blocked. Its charge goes off when it dies, hurting nearby ground enemies.

land_dreadnought.name: Land Dreadnought
land_dreadnought.desc: Legendary landship. Its cannon deals splash damage while two sponson gunners shoot ground and air. When it falls, the crew bails out as two Carbineers.

gatling_gun.name: Gatling Gun
gatling_gun.desc: Cranks out a stream of bullets at a single target. Hits ground and air.

mortar_pit.name: Mortar Pit
mortar_pit.desc: Lobs shells at close range for splash damage. Breaks up swarms near your gate.

boiler_mortar.name: Boiler Mortar
boiler_mortar.desc: Steam-driven heavy mortar with big splash damage at long range. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

tesla_tower.name: Tesla Tower
tesla_tower.desc: Lightning that jumps between 4 enemies and stuns each one briefly. Hits ground and air.

trench_raider.name: Trench Raider
trench_raider.desc: Tough close-combat infantry. Blunt against armor.

rifleman.name: Rifleman
rifleman.desc: Long-range rifle fire. Suppressing Fire: hits slow the target. Hits ground and air.

tankette.name: Tankette
tankette.desc: Light tank with a short-range cannon. Armored and mech.

bazooka_trooper.name: Bazooka Trooper
bazooka_trooper.desc: Anti-heavy rockets: triple damage to armored and mech targets, which it aims at first. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses. Hits ground and air.

radio_operator.name: Radio Operator
radio_operator.desc: Support. Every 8 s calls an artillery shell onto the nearest ground enemy. Stays behind the front line.

gyrocopter.name: Gyrocopter
gyrocopter.desc: Air gunship with a rapid machine gun. Only units and turrets that hit air can fight it.

behemoth_tank.name: Behemoth Tank
behemoth_tank.desc: Legendary super-heavy tank. Its main gun deals splash damage at long range while a machine gun shoots down air units.

mg_nest.name: MG Nest
mg_nest.desc: Sprays bullets at a single target. Hits ground and air.

flak_gun.name: Flak Gun
flak_gun.desc: Flak shells burst for splash damage, double against air. Aims at air first.

howitzer.name: Howitzer
howitzer.desc: Long-range artillery with heavy splash damage. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

searchlight_sniper.name: Searchlight Sniper
searchlight_sniper.desc: Picks off armored targets first and marks them: marked enemies take 20% more damage from everything.

photon_knight.name: Photon Knight
photon_knight.desc: Infantry with an energy shield that recharges after a few seconds without damage. Blunt against armor.

pulse_trooper.name: Pulse Trooper
pulse_trooper.desc: Fires fast plasma bolts at long range. Hits ground and air.

walker_mech.name: Walker Mech
walker_mech.desc: Armored walker that strikes from the second rank.

rail_gunner.name: Rail Gunner
rail_gunner.desc: Anti-heavy. An instant rail shot pierces two enemies and deals double damage to armored and mech targets. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses. Hits ground and air.

repair_drone.name: Repair Drone
repair_drone.desc: Flying support. Repairs the two most wounded allies nearby. It does not attack.

emp_saboteur.name: EMP Saboteur
emp_saboteur.desc: Fast saboteur. Its EMP strips enemy shields and stuns nearby mech units, even in the air.

chrono_titan.name: Chrono Titan
chrono_titan.desc: Legendary time colossus. Cleaves three enemies at once and freezes everything nearby in time every 20 s.

pulse_laser.name: Pulse Laser
pulse_laser.desc: Instant laser pulses at a single target. Hits ground and air.

arc_coil.name: Arc Coil
arc_coil.desc: Lightning that jumps between 3 enemies. Hits ground and air.

plasma_mortar.name: Plasma Mortar
plasma_mortar.desc: Lobs plasma for heavy splash damage at long range. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
gravity_well.desc: Fires into the thickest crowd: damages up to 4 ground enemies, then pulls everyone nearby together and slows them.

star_legionnaire.name: Star Legionnaire
star_legionnaire.desc: Infantry with an energy blade. Deflector: takes 20% less damage from ranged attacks. Blunt against armor.

ion_ranger.name: Ion Ranger
ion_ranger.desc: Ion bolts arc to one more enemy nearby. Hits ground and air.

hover_tank.name: Hover Tank
hover_tank.desc: Armored hover tank with a short-range plasma cannon. Hovers, but still fights on the ground.

graviton_halberdier.name: Graviton Halberdier
graviton_halberdier.desc: Anti-heavy with reach. Brace: immune to knockback and charge bonuses. Deals triple damage to armored and mech targets.

starwarden.name: Starwarden
starwarden.desc: Support. Every 8 s in a fight its beacon shields the 4 nearest allies. Stays behind the front line.

warp_stalker.name: Warp Stalker
warp_stalker.desc: Fast skirmisher. Blink: when blocked, warps past the front to strike an enemy ranged or support unit for double damage.

mothership.name: Mothership
mothership.desc: Legendary air gunship. Fires on ground and air and every 10 s calls a drone strike on a ground enemy. Crashes with a big explosion when shot down.

ion_turret.name: Ion Turret
ion_turret.desc: Instant ion beam at a single target. Hits ground and air.

starburst_gun.name: Starburst Gun
starburst_gun.desc: Blasts the frontmost enemy and everyone just behind it. Hits ground and air.

starfall_battery.name: Starfall Battery
starfall_battery.desc: Launches star shards far across the lane for heavy splash damage. Cannot hit targets close to your gate.

tachyon_lance.name: Tachyon Lance

apollo_arrow.name: Apollo’s Arrow

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.desc: Caltrops in your half snare up to 6 ground enemies for 8 s: they move and attack slower.

knights_charge.name: Knights’ Charge

undermine.name: Undermine

volley_fire.name: Volley Fire

ion_cannon.name: Ion Cannon

sling_perch.name: Sling Perch
sling_perch.desc: A field tower: a slinger on a Home pad who shoots ground and air in front of your base. It never shoots bases or walls. Heavies break it twice as fast.

war_camp.name: War Camp
war_camp.desc: A camp that sends a very weak Cave Youth every 10 s, one at a time. Levies always march and pay no bounty. The camp stops in Siege.

spike_pit.name: Spike Pit
spike_pit.desc: A trap on a Home pad, always visible. The first enemy ground unit to step on it is stabbed and slowed. Three charges; never hits air.

cave_youth.name: Cave Youth
cave_youth.desc: A very weak levy sent by a War Camp. It always marches.

cyclopean_wall.name: Cyclopean Wall

muster_tents.desc: A camp that sends a very weak Citizen Levy every 10 s, one at a time. Levies always march and pay no bounty. The camp stops in Siege.

citizen_levy.name: Citizen Levy

peasant_levy.name: Peasant Levy

gabion_wall.name: Gabion Wall

musket_redoubt.desc: A field tower on a Home pad. Its musketeers fire at ground and air in front of your base, never at bases or walls. Heavies break it twice as fast.

militia_muster.desc: A camp that sends a very weak Militiaman every 10 s, one at a time. Levies always march and pay no bounty. The camp stops in Siege.

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
powder_keg.desc: A buried keg on a Home pad, always visible. When an enemy ground unit reaches it, it blows up the group around it. One charge; never hits air.

militiaman.name: Militiaman
militiaman.desc: A very weak levy sent by a Militia Muster. It always marches.

trench_parapet.name: Trench Parapet

sniper_nest.desc: A field tower on a Home pad. Its sniper shoots ground and air in front of your base, never bases or walls. Heavies break it twice as fast.

tripwire_charge.name: Tripwire Charge
tripwire_charge.desc: A wired charge on a Home pad, always visible. An enemy ground unit that trips it sets off a blast. Two charges; never hits air.

volunteer.name: Volunteer
volunteer.desc: A very weak levy sent by a Recruiting Depot. It always marches.

sandbag_bunker.name: Sandbag Bunker
sandbag_bunker.desc: A sandbag wall. It stops enemy ground units in front of your turrets, and your troops just behind it take 20% less damage from ranged attacks. Heavies break walls twice as fast; it crumbles after a minute.

pillbox.name: Pillbox
pillbox.desc: A concrete field tower on a Home pad. Its gun fires at ground and air in front of your base, never at bases or walls. Heavies break it twice as fast.

forward_base.name: Forward Base

conscript.name: Conscript
conscript.desc: A very weak levy sent by a Forward Base. It always marches.

hardlight_barrier.name: Hardlight Barrier
hardlight_barrier.desc: A wall of solid light. It stops enemy ground units in front of your turrets and regenerates when left alone for 3 s, until it starts to crumble. Heavies break walls twice as fast.

sentry_pylon.name: Sentry Pylon
sentry_pylon.desc: A field tower on a Home pad. Its beam hits ground and air in front of your base, never bases or walls. Heavies break it twice as fast.

clone_cadet.name: Clone Cadet
clone_cadet.desc: A very weak levy sent by a Clone Bay. It always marches.

void_rampart.name: Void Rampart

ion_spire.name: Ion Spire

warp_barracks.name: Warp Barracks

void_mine.name: Void Mine
void_mine.desc: A mine on a Home pad, always visible. An enemy ground unit that reaches it sets off a void blast. Two charges; never hits air.

star_recruit.name: Star Recruit
star_recruit.desc: A very weak levy sent by the Warp Barracks. It always marches.

greenwood_archer.name: Greenwood Archer
greenwood_archer.look: Feathered cap and a leaf cloak

chess_knight.name: Chess Knight

bone_wyrm.name: Bone Wyrm
bone_wyrm.look: A skeletal dragon with ghost-green fire

parade_cuirassier.name: Parade Cuirassier
parade_cuirassier.look: Gleaming parade cuirass and a horsehair crest

fireworks_grenadier.name: Fireworks Grenadier
fireworks_grenadier.look: Bombs that burst as firework spheres

pufferfish_balloon.name: Pufferfish Balloon

ghost_corsair.name: Ghost Corsair
ghost_corsair.look: Translucent body with a pale glow

snowball_pebbler.name: Snowball Pebbler

aurora_elk.name: Aurora Elk

obsidian_colossus.name: Obsidian Colossus
obsidian_colossus.look: Black volcanic glass with glowing cracks

stone.name: Stone Age
stone.mechanic: Melee, ranged, heavies, knockback, charges and ricochet

bronze.name: Bronze Age: Hellas
bronze.mechanic: Piercing throws, damage auras, turret stuns and the sweep power
bronze.flavour: Hoplites, gorgons and bronze giants under the eyes of the old gods.

medieval.name: Medieval Age
medieval.mechanic: Reach, shields, damage resistance and siege damage to bases

gunpowder.name: Age of Muskets
gunpowder.mechanic: Splash artillery, pulls, mech units and the first air unit
gunpowder.flavour: Drums, drilled lines of muskets and cannon smoke over the field.

industrial.name: Industrial Age: Great War
industrial.mechanic: Mech heavies, marking support, exploding runners, stun chains and a crewed Legendary
industrial.flavour: Steam, rail and landships grinding across the trenches.

modern.name: Modern Age
modern.mechanic: Air as a regular option, suppression and called strikes

future.name: Future Age
future.mechanic: Energy shields, EMP stuns and time control

cosmic.name: Cosmic Age
cosmic.mechanic: Blink skirmishers, shield projectors and an air Legendary with called strikes

tutorial.name: Training
tutorial.desc: Stone Age to Future Age, no clock.

last.name: Last Base Standing
last.desc: 7 ages, no clock: the Siege rises until a base falls.

grogg.name: Old Grogg
grogg.signature: Sends Training Dummies and never evolves.
grogg.disclosure: Training match: Grogg's base starts at 90%.

pip.name: Pip Quickstep
pip.signature: Opens with Ranged, then Infantry, then leans on Heavies.

kettle.name: Captain Kettle
kettle.signature: Infantry spam and an all-in push before each evolve.

moss.name: Mama Moss
moss.signature: Early turrets, holds the line, pushes in Overdrive.

ledger.name: Baroness Ledger
ledger.signature: Economy research first and evolves first. Weak before 1:00.

boomsworth.name: Sgt. Boomsworth
boomsworth.signature: Trebuchet, Scorpion, Bronze Cannon, Boiler Mortar, Howitzer, Starfall Battery and Grenadier.

twins.name: Ada & Ivo
twins.signature: The Twins: two portraits, one AI General.

rook.name: Rook
rook.signature: Weighs counters extra and switches within seconds.

tempest.name: Madame Tempest
tempest.signature: Saves Age Powers for evolves and clumps.

warden.name: The Warden
warden.signature: Final boss of Arena 8 and Conquest.
warden.line: Every age ends. Yours ends here.
warden.disclosure: Brings all eight Legendaries at level 9.

echo.name: Echo of You
echo.signature: Plays your own active War Plan.
echo.line: Let's see how you like it.

fast_final_age.name: Reach your format's final age before 3:00 (Short), 6:45 (Standard) or 11:30 (Full)

power_hits_5.name: Hit 5+ enemies with one Age Power (a bombard, sweep, charge, front barrage, snare, pull or stun)

win_with_legendary.name: Win with a Legendary in your War Plan

power_hour.name: Power Hour
power_hour.desc: Age Powers reload twice as fast and cost half.

heavy_metal.name: Heavy Metal
heavy_metal.desc: Heavy and Legendary units cost 30% less.

evolver.name: Evolver
evolver.unlock: Reach the last age of a Long War or Last Base Standing

speedrunner.name: Speedrunner
speedrunner.unlock: Reach the last age of a Long War (or Last Base Standing) before 10:00

caveman_diplomacy.name: Caveman Diplomacy
caveman_diplomacy.hint: A Stone Age unit kills a Future Age unit.

arrows_into_tomorrow.name: Arrows into Tomorrow

stubborn.name: Stubborn
stubborn.hint: Win a Medium or Long War (or Last Base Standing) without evolving past Medieval.

no_walls.name: No Walls
no_walls.hint: Win a Long War (or Last Base Standing) without building a turret.

photo_finish.name: Photo Finish
photo_finish.hint: Win at the Final Bell by 2% base HP or less.

horn_of_legends.name: Horn of Legends

lightspeed.name: Lightspeed
lightspeed.hint: Reach the Future Age before 9:00 in a Long War or Last Base Standing.

underdog.name: Underdog
underdog.hint: Win after your opponent was two ages ahead of you.

humble_beginnings.name: Humble Beginnings
humble_beginnings.hint: Win a Long War (or Last Base Standing) with only Common cards and starter powers in your plan.

back_from_the_brink.name: Back from the Brink

old_guard.name: Old Guard

forage.name: Forage
forage.desc: +40% kill bounty for kills in your own half.

bulwark.name: Bulwark

hunters.name: Hunters

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: While you Hold, their first hit in a fight deals +40%.

skirmish.name: Skirmish
skirmish.desc: Anti-heavy units take 20% less damage from Infantry.

mail.name: Mail
mail.desc: Support units take less damage from every hit.

war_drums.name: War Drums
war_drums.desc: Allies near a Support unit attack 8% faster.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Allies near a Support unit take 10% less damage.

war_horns.name: War Horns
